entities.summary: Melchisedec Sikuli Paluku is a Congolese Catholic prelate who is the bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Butembo-Beni in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since 3 April 1998. Before that, from 21 August 1978 until he was appointed bishop, he was a priest of that same Roman Catholic diocese. He was appointed bishop on 3 April 1998 by Pope John Paul II. He was consecrated and installed at Butembo/Beni on 2 August 1998.
